I told Hollis in a thread on their message in #central-team that the site for the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is **Gate 47**.

Pree first posted Dock 23 in that channel on the 14th, then corrected it to Gate 47 the same morning. Nothing newer has been posted there since. Hollis is a member of #central-team, so all of this was already visible to them.
